children.name: Netskope - Alert Details
children.description: Alert Details Dashboard provides a visual presentation of alert analytics, including the geographic locations of suspicious source and destination IPs, a time compare of alters, alert outlier trends over time, alerts by application, and recent alerts with a poor cloud confidence level.

panels.name: Suspicious Source IP Locations
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope
| json "_id", "alert", "srcip", "dstip", "alert_name", "alert_type", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity" as alert_id, alert, src_ip, dest_ip, alert_name, alert_type, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity nodrop
| where ccl matches {{CLOUD_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL}} and !isNull(alert_type)
| count by src_ip, alert
| where !isPrivateIP(src_ip) and  alert="yes"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip=src_ip

panels.name: Suspicious Destination IP Locations
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "yes"
| json "_id", "alert", "srcip", "dstip", "alert_name", "alert_type", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity" as alert_id, alert, src_ip, dest_ip, alert_name, alert_type, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity nodrop
| where ccl matches {{CLOUD_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL}} and !isNull(alert_type)
| count by dest_ip, alert
| where !isPrivateIP(dest_ip) and  alert="yes" 
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip=dest_ip

panels.name: Alerts by Application
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope
| json "_id", "srcip", "dstip", "alert", "alert_name", "alert_type", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity" as alert_id, src_ip, dest_ip, is_alert, alert_name, alert_type, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity nodrop
| where ccl matches {{CLOUD_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL}} and  is_alert="yes" and !isNull(alert_type)
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, app
| transpose row _timeslice column app

panels.name: Alerts - Time Compare Today vs Last Week Avg
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "yes"
| json "_id", "srcip", "dstip", "alert_name", "alert", "alert_type", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity" as alert_id, src_ip, dest_ip, alert_name, is_alert, alert_type, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity nodrop
| where is_alert="yes" and ccl matches {{CLOUD_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL}} and !isNull(alert_type)
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice
| compare with timeshift -1w 1 avg as last_week_avg

panels.name: Alerts Outlier Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "yes"
| json "_id", "srcip", "dstip", "alert", "alert_name", "alert_type", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity" as alert_id, src_ip, dest_ip, is_alert, alert_name, alert_type, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity nodrop
| timeslice 1h
| where ccl matches {{CLOUD_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL}} and is_alert="yes" and !isNull(alert_type)
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)
| count(alert_id) as todays_views by _timeslice
| compare with timeshift 1d as vs_yesterday| (todays_views - todays_views_vs_yesterday) as delta
| outlier delta threshold = 2, window = 5, consecutive=2

panels.name: Recent Alerts with Poor Cloud Confidence Level
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope "yes"
| json "_id", "srcip", "dstip", "alert", "alert_name", "alert_type", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity" as alert_id, src_ip, dest_ip, is_alert, alert_name, alert_type, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity nodrop
| count by user, alert_name, alert_type, app, site, appcategory, acked, device, os, src_ip, dest_ip, timestamp, ccl, activity, is_alert
| where ccl matches {{CLOUD_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL}} and is_alert="yes" and !isNull(alert_type)
| sort by timestamp
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(timestamp*1000)),"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as alert_date
| fields alert_date, alert_name, alert_type, user, activity, app, site, ccl, src_ip, dest_ip, appcategory, device, os

queryParameters.name: CLOUD_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
queryParameters.label: CLOUD_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
queryParameters.description: The Netskope CCI is an objective measure of a cloud service’s enterprise readiness and is adapted from the Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM).

panels.name: User Activity on Infected machines
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Netskope ("Malware" OR "nspolicy")
| join (json "_id", "srcip", "dstip", "alert_name", "alert_type", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity", "action", "browser", "file_type", "instance_name", "malware_id", "malware_name", "malware_severity", "malware_type", "object_type", "object", "object_count" as alert_id, src_ip, dst_ip, alert_name, alert_type, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity, action, browser, file_type, instance_name, malware_id, malware_name, malware_severity, malware_type, object_type, object, object_count nodrop
| where alert_type = "Malware"
| max(timestamp) as latest_alert_date by src_ip) as UT,
(json "_id", "alert", "alert_type","type", "srcip", "dstip", "appcategory", "app", "os", "user", "device", "acked", "site", "timestamp", "ccl", "activity", "browser", "object", "object_type", "from_user", "to_user" as alert_id, is_alert, alert_type, type, src_ip, dest_ip, appcategory, app, os, user, device, acked, site, timestamp, ccl, activity, browser, object, object_type, from_user, to_user nodrop
| where is_alert="no" and isNull(alert_type) and type="nspolicy"
| fields src_ip, user, activity, timestamp) as  AUT
on UT.src_ip = AUT.src_ip
| where AUT_timestamp >= UT_latest_alert_date
| UT_src_ip as src_ip
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(UT_latest_alert_date*1000)),"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as latest_alert_date
